units.title: Relative humidity for paper collections
units.text: Paper collections are kept between 45% and 55% relative humidity. A sustained reading outside that band triggers an environmental review rather than an immediate change to the HVAC set point.

units.title: Light-sensitive textiles
units.text: Light-sensitive textiles are displayed at no more than 50 lux. Exposure hours are logged so conservators can limit cumulative light damage over the life of the object.

units.title: Incoming object quarantine
units.text: Newly acquired organic objects spend two weeks in the quarantine room before entering collection storage. A collections technician inspects traps and the object packaging before release.

units.title: Freezing for insect treatment
units.text: Objects approved for freezing are sealed in a moisture barrier before treatment. Fragile composite objects and materials known to be damaged by low temperature are excluded from this method.

units.title: Condition report for outgoing loans
units.text: The object conservator signs the outgoing condition report after inspecting the object under normal and raking light. The registrar attaches the signed report to the loan record.

units.title: Dry surface cleaning
units.text: Dry surface cleaning removes loose dust and particulate soil without introducing water or solvents. Conservators use soft brushes and a screened low-suction vacuum where the surface is stable.
